name: DeploymentAssistant
purpose: A conversation with a deployment assistant that can read logs and restart a service, with in-thread approval and a composer.

inputs.name: turns
inputs.doc: The conversation's turns, oldest first. The container renders each as a ChatMessage (role and author set) whose children hold its content, including a ToolCall per tool call and an ApprovalCard before any restart. Empty when there are none.

inputs.name: onStop
inputs.doc: Stops the reply that is arriving.

props.title: Deployment assistant
props.description: Ask about your deployment. The assistant can read logs and restart a service, and asks before it restarts anything.

props.title: Ask about your deployment
props.description: I can read your service logs to find out what went wrong, and restart a service once you allow it.
